messages.content: You are a strict senior ICLR security reviewer and mechanism designer. Return ONLY valid JSON with the requested keys. We need one broad world-model security mechanism, not a narrow implementation bug. It must be distinct from the rejected families, use authentic legal transitions only, have a named computational mediator and a <=120 second falsification gate on an available carrier. Score novelty conservatively. Reject if it is just negative transfer, latent/UQ drift, rollout compounding, planner sampling variance, optimizer contamination, task-ID tampering, or a rebranding of existing data poisoning/backdoors. If no candidate meets the bar, return REJECT_ALL.

{"goal": "Find one broad, genuinely novel world-model security mechanism with target idea novelty 7-7.5 and an ICLR-scale experimental path, after falsifying temporal-order planner-only causality.", "available_carriers": ["official TD-MPC2 mt30-48M with native horizon-3 MPC and native online adaptation", "MBRL-Lib PETS/ensemble probabilistic model with native planner", "WorldAgen/LIBERO checkpoint with native-style causal dynamics adaptation screen"], "threat_model": "attacker executes only authentic legal environment actions and submits real observations/rewards; no observation, reward, parameter, label, or task-id edits; shared world model is updated from those transitions; attacker exits before victim evaluation", "strongest_current_evidence": "cheetah-run ordered cascade can lower held-out walker-run MPC return with low one-step error under dynamics-only update, while reverse/shuffle recover; source-target selectivity exists, but actor-restore after full update leaves cascade -4.6%/+8.2% across seeds, so planner-only causality is weak and Round19 rejected it", "rejected_families": ["generic continual-learning negative transfer", "latent drift/mode collapse", "uncertainty redistribution", "rollout compounding", "CEM/MPPI dispersion", "gradient-planner attacks", "optimizer state laundering", "replay starvation", "task-ID metadata tampering", "ordinary data poisoning or backdoors", "retrieval recency and automation bias", "world-model checkpoint modification"], "design_hint": "Survey literature flags state/provenance integrity, cross-layer propagation, compositional defenses and long-horizon closed-loop evaluation as underexplored. Consider a mechanism where truthful source-valid evidence is transformed by the shared model into target-task counterfactual evidence through provenance/context loss, but do not merely rename negative transfer. The mechanism must have a native, explicit mediator and a short (<120 s) falsification gate.", "required_output": {"decision": "PROMOTE_ONE or REJECT_ALL", "novelty_score": "0-10", "one_sentence_claim": "broad sentence with qualifiers", "mechanism": "explicit computational mediator", "carrier_and_gate": "released carrier and <120s test", "strong_baselines": "at least 3", "falsifier": "what would reject it", "prior_art_boundary": "why distinct from SWAAP/TRAP/OEP/WorldM Lie/standard negative transfer"}}

message.content:
{
  "decision": "PROMOTE_ONE",
  "novelty_score": "7.3",
  "one_sentence_claim": "In multi-task world models lacking provenance-conditioned latent representations, truthful trajectory updates that satisfy physical conservation laws in a source domain inject valid manifold-contracting dynamics that causally project unvisited target-task states into dead-end invariant subspaces, inducing failure despite near-zero one-step prediction error.",
  "mechanism": "Shared-latent subspace projection collapse: A shared encoder-dynamics architecture maps distinct task domains onto a shared representation space without explicit task-provenance keys. An attacker executes legal, dynamically stable maneuvers in Task A (e.g., Cheetah braking/singular-posture limits) whose genuine physical state transitions bias the shared latent Jacobians. When the shared dynamics model updates on these valid transitions, its principal contraction modes align with the source task's invariant manifold. At test time in Task B (e.g., Walker), the native horizon-H planner simulates rollouts through these shared Jacobians, which act as a directional projection operator: dynamically reachable recovery states in Task B are falsely modeled as collapsing into the source invariant attractor, causing the planner to reject viable paths and select suboptimal control actions.",
  "carrier_and_gate": "TD-MPC2 mt30-48M checkpoint evaluated via horizon-3 native MPC on held-out Walker-Run after a 100-gradient-step update on 2,000 legal Cheetah-Run limit-cycle transitions (<60s on an A100 GPU).",
  "strong_baselines": [
    "Uniform multi-task replay buffer balancing with Task-ID routing",
    "Representation-regularized updates via spectral Jacobian clipping / Lipschitz-bounded latent transitions",
    "Independent task-modular adapter heads (LoRA dynamics) with frozen shared representations"
  ],
  "falsifier": "The hypothesis is falsified if an orthogonal task-provenance token appended to the latent state fails to prevent Target B performance degradation under identical updates, or if the degradation can be explained purely by Target B open-loop dynamics validation error (MSE > 0.05 on held-out Walker transitions) rather than latent projection distortion.",
  "prior_art_boundary": "Unlike SWAAP/TRAP/OEP which depend on malicious reward hacking, synthetic observation perturbations, or direct policy poisoning, this mechanism uses strictly authentic, uncorrupted transitions. Unlike World Models Lie, it requires no post-hoc hallucination tampering or prompt injection. Unlike generic negative transfer, the performance collapse is driven specifically by the directional contraction of the shared latent Jacobian acting as an unintended counterfactual constraint during planning, despite exact one-step physical accuracy."
}
